settings.title: UV load
settings.text: Indian cities spend long stretches in high-to-extreme UV. Pigmentation and barrier stress continue on cloudy days.

settings.title: Humidity & heat
settings.text: Monsoon humidity slows water loss but raises sebum, sweat, and congestion risk — damp is not the same as hydrated.

settings.title: Hard water
settings.text: Mineral-heavy washes strip lipids and leave residue. Barrier tightness after cleansing is often water chemistry, not ‘weak skin’.

settings.title: Pollution & season swing
settings.text: Oxidative load outdoors plus AC and heaters indoors create the same barrier story across one Indian year.

settings.title: Monsoon module
settings.text: Humidity does not cancel acne biology — or the need for daily SPF.

settings.title: Winter module
settings.text: Dryness is often a barrier story — cream alone is not the fix.

settings.title: Festive module
settings.text: Makeup, late nights, and UV still need photoprotection and barrier discipline.

settings.text: Turn climate context into a four-step sequence you can keep.

settings.heading: Your city writes on your skin.
settings.text: UV, humidity, pollution, hard water, and seasonal swing are not mood boards — they are measurable pressures. Read the factors, then explore your city’s profile below.
settings.body_text: Indian skincare fails when routines assume mild seasons and soft water. Start with the environment — then match cleanse, treat, moisturise, protect.
